data.name: Typing Hero
data.detailed_description:
WISHLIST NOW


About the Game

After five (5) years, it's time for Sam to retire...

Jack and Amy are now back in town...

In a world filled with Zombies, the last survivors of a Spec Ops squad try to survive,

and make their way through Hordes of Zombies to reach their final destination.

OVERVIEW

Typing Hero is a Typing Zombie Survival Zombie Experience game.

Play in Handcrafted game levels utilizing stylized graphics.

Type as fast as you can and try to keep yourself alive for as long as possible.

Be fast and accurate with your typing to keep your combos high and increase the points that you earn.

Use the points that you earned to buy upgrades to die less and unlock new weapons.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

Choose between two playable heroes Jack or Amy and customize them as much as you want.
Helmets, Face masks, Hair colors, and different camos.

UPGRADES

Upgrade your hero by purchasing upgrades with the points that you earned during playing.
Purchase Body armor to die harder and different weapons with unique upgrades of their own.

FEATURES

  • Two (2) playable heroes, Jack & Amy.

  • 5 different difficulty levels to play with, and a harder difficulty level awards more points.

  • A lot of Different Zombies to keep the game interesting.

  • 10 Unique hand-crafted maps to play with, utilizing stylized graphics.

  • Unique Bosses to make your life harder.

  • Statistics and Typing Statistics (Kills, Waves Survived, Combos, Time Survived, Wpm (Words Per Minute), Words Typed, Letters Typed, Total Errors, and more)

  • Multiple Language Support for the UI (English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Greek)

  • Steam integrated - Keep your Score and Stats safe with your Steam profile.

  • Steam Achievements

  • Custom Dictionary

  • Color Blindness support

  • Hand Placement Guide.

  • DLSS4.5 & XESS3 & FSR3 Support.
